about_the_game:
🌌 What if the meteor shower that destroyed Earth… wasn’t natural at all?

Generations ago, humanity fled to the orbital colony ARD, leaving Earth behind after a “meteor storm” scorched the surface. But now, a mysterious distress signal calls you back — and you discover the truth: the meteors were the first alien strike, and a resistance still fights on Earth’s surface.

You are Gravity, a skilled pilot caught between duty, family, and survival. Guided first by your sister Aurora, and later joined by resistance fighter Ryan, you must uncover fragments of the past, face overwhelming alien forces, and make the ultimate choice: defend Earth in a last stand, or save ARD in orbit.

 

🔥 Features

  • Story + Action Fusion → A bullet-hell SHMUP with a branching narrative full of betrayal, sacrifice, and two possible endings.

  • Epic Environments → Fight across deserts, oceans, jungles, frozen tundra, volcanic craters, and into space itself.

  • Upgrade & Crafting Systems → Customize your ship through the Arsenal upgrade system and build powerful support drones.

  • Dynamic Metal Soundtrack → A heavy-metal score that reacts to your combat, escalating with boss fights.

  • Ranked PvP Mode → Test your skills in 1v1 duels, climb seasonal ladders, and unlock cosmetic rewards like portraits, frames, and banners.

  • Lore & Exploration → Collect fragments to uncover the truth of Earth’s fall, humanity’s betrayal, and your family’s fate.

The battle for humanity isn’t just about survival — it’s about who we choose to become.

Gear up, pilot. Beyond Solar begins where Earth awakens.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i5
  • Graphics: GeForce 400 Series
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Core i7
  • Graphics: GeForce 1080

short_description: Embark on a thrilling bullet hell/SHMUP journey in Beyond Solar. As "Gravity," a space pilot from the colony ARD, defend humanity's last sanctuary amid Earth's impending doom. Brace yourself for intense pixel art action in a desperate fight for survival.
supported_languages:
English*, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
